title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Experimental Common Test build 0.1.8-beta.12 for WoT 2.4.2.0 Common Test #996 (client revision 2660091). Not a production EU/NA/ASIA release.
Remove fog is off by default for new installations. The option can still be turned on manually; the separate package is installed after the game is closed.
Existing explicit Remove fog preferences are kept. A profile file without the removeFog entry, with the Driftkings package installed for the client, is migrated to true.
Starting the game, opening the settings panel, reloading settings and switching profiles never remove the Remove fog package. The master switch never removes it.
Turning Remove fog off removes the Driftkings package after the game is closed. The main driftkings.wotmod is not changed by this option.

Known limitation: if a profile file disappears during a session, the client may recreate a default OFF preference after a restart while an installed Remove fog package remains. Turn the option on and then off again, and close the game, to remove it.

Earlier 0.1.8 beta changes: adapted hangar carousel and crew-tooltip patches, refreshed CT Flash libraries and native vehicle markers, fixed fog package destination for the declared Common Test mod folder.

Earlier 0.1.8 beta changes: integrated the approved settings header and Account Manager icon; added optional health-bar frames above the native ammunition and consumables panel (pending in-game validation).
